train_diffusion_model: train a diffusion model by finetuning a pretrained DDPMPipeline on a custom image dataset
load_diffusion_pipeline: load a pretrained DDPMPipeline and configure a DDIMScheduler for sampling
prepare_image_dataset: prepare a HuggingFace dataset with image preprocessing transforms for diffusion model training
finetune_unet_model: finetune the UNet of a diffusion model with AdamW optimizer and gradient accumulation
generate_and_log_samples: generate image samples from a diffusion model and log them to wandb during training
